title: LEGO SPIKE Simulator lesson
description: A lesson students work through in the simulator's Lessons window. See docs/lessons.md.

topic.description: Groups lessons, for example Basics, Sensors, Gyro or Missions.

order.description: Position within the topic, lowest first.

summary.description: One line shown in the lesson list.

steps.description: What the student does, in order. Students tick each one off.

text.description: Plain text. Blank lines start a new paragraph.

program.description: Starter program: a .llsp3 file name in the library (or in programs/ in the zip).

field.description: Field to practise on: a .spk scene name in the library (or in scenes/ in the zip).

robot.description: Robot to use: a .mpd or .ldr name in the library (or in robots/ in the zip).

challenge.description: Id of a built-in challenge the simulator checks, for example first-square.
